stem: Sales of cell phones at a certain shop occur singly, randomly and independently.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State one further condition that must be satisfied for the number of sales in a certain time period to be well modelled by a Poisson distribution.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
The average number of sales per hour is 1.2 .

Assume now that a Poisson distribution is a suitable model.
parts.text: Find the probability that the number of sales during a randomly chosen 12-hour period will be more than 12 and less than 16.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to find the probability that the number of sales during a randomly chosen 1-month period (140 hours) will be less than 150.
